blockers.summary: No canonical Vossie specifications exist in the repository (only README.md and the runtime ZIP). Atlas cannot catalog canonical_refs, build the dependency graph, or assign specialist tasks without inventing requirements.
blockers.resolution: Canonical specification package committed under docs/specs/ (DEC-001); stack confirmed (DEC-002).

decisions_required.question: Provide the canonical Vossie specification package (177-screen map, screen specs, architecture/data decisions) by committing it to the repository (e.g. docs/specs/) or linking the authoritative source (e.g. Figma file URLs).
decisions_required.resolution: Human supplied the specification package on 2026-09-30; committed under docs/specs/ and cataloged in canonical_refs. Per-screen contracts: REF-GUIDE appendix.

decisions_required.question: Confirm the application stack/tooling for the adaptive single-deployment PWA (framework, package manager, hosting). Supabase is referenced by AGENT-CONTRACTS.md; the frontend framework and deployment target are not yet approved in-repo.
decisions_required.resolution: Locked stack per REF-LOCKED, REF-KB 07_ENGINEERING/01_TECH_STACK and REF-DS1 Decision 03: TypeScript, Next.js + React PWA, Tailwind + Radix/shadcn-derived UI, TypeScript modular monolith, PostgreSQL on Supabase, Drizzle, Zod, Supabase Realtime, Vitest + Playwright, pnpm + Turborepo monorepo, GitHub Actions, Vercel + Supabase. Confirmed to human 2026-09-30 without objection.

decisions_required.question: Keep or remove Vossie-Devin-Multi-Agent-Runtime.zip from the repository root now that its contents are installed.
decisions_required.resolution: Keep the ZIP; kept in sync with the installed runtime (human: 'update everything', 2026-09-30).

decisions_required.question: REF-GUIDE ch.02-04 proposes Expo/React Native clients, a NestJS API and a BullMQ/Redis worker; REF-LOCKED and REF-DS1 lock a single adaptive Next.js PWA on Supabase.
decisions_required.resolution: Locked decisions outrank the Guide (precedence 1 vs 4; the Guide labels itself a proposal). Build the single Next.js PWA with server-side route handlers/server actions; treat Guide API endpoints as contract shapes, not a NestJS mandate. Human may override.

decisions_required.question: Prototype screenshots (brand/production-studio-overview.png, brand/prototype-login-showcase.jpeg) use a deep green primary, while the brand identity and the live production studio use navy #29475B.
decisions_required.resolution: Brand identity (precedence 2) wins: navy #29475B primary on ivory #FAF8F2. Green screenshots are non-authoritative references. Human may override.

decisions_required.question: Supply the approved vector logo (wordmark + ss icon) and confirm the licensed UI typeface.
decisions_required.note: Does not block Stage 1; prototypes use a marked text stand-in (REF-GUIDE ch.01).

decisions_required.question: Business/provider decisions in REF-OPEN and REF-GUIDE ch.33: pilot campuses/hubs, identity federation, payment provider and funds custody, fee schedule, food rules, retention, hosting region, support ownership.
decisions_required.note: Does not block Stage 1; Stage 2 uses sandbox adapters and no real-money pilot starts until resolved.

decisions_required.question: Should verified online-only students participate, and if so which capabilities are available without a physical campus/hub (buying, selling, courier, collection, delivery, transfers and incubation)?
decisions_required.note: The product owner asked Atlas to consider online students. This does not block the current foundation tasks; it must be resolved before location, eligibility and fulfilment rules are finalized.
